node.title: PROVED (autonomous x24, replayed 15/15): char-0 dyadic trades ARE full fibers
node.statement: n = 2^s, H = mu_n(C): disjoint h-subsets P, Q with equal first h-1 elementary symmetric sums satisfy — h not a power of two: NO such trade exists; h a power of two: P and Q are full mu_h fibers (the PAID cyclic class). Characteristic-zero dyadic trades are EXACTLY cyclic full-fiber trades. The antipodal-descent classification, completed.
